title: 纽约豪宅税遭叫停：1.7万业主信已发出，税基或大幅缩水？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The rollout of New York City, Zoraan Mamdani's New York City mayor, Zoraan Mamdani's new Pieda tear tax was temporarily blocked by a state court judge on Staten Island.
segments.zh: 纽约市长穆罕默德提出的豪宅税，被史泰登岛州法院法官暂时叫停。

segments.en: Bloomberg senior reporter Laura Namias has been reporting on that story, and she joins us for more.
segments.zh: 彭博社资深记者劳拉·纳米亚斯一直在跟进此事，下面请她带来最新消息。

segments.en: Thanks for joining us, Laura. So just give us the latest.
segments.zh: 劳拉，感谢你的参与，请说说最新进展。

segments.en: So the Pieda tear tax temporarily blocked by a judge, by a judge pending both sides meeting in court on August 31st, lovely, Labor Day weekend for everyone involved.
segments.zh: 豪宅税被法官暂时叫停，双方将于8月31日再次出庭，正好是劳动节周末。

segments.en: But the city has filed a counter-motion arguing that they want to try to keep implementing the tax until that date when the judge makes another decision.
segments.zh: 但市政府已提出反诉，希望在法官做出新决定前继续实施该税。

segments.en: But this is a roadblock for a tax that is on a very tight timeline to be implemented.
segments.zh: 不过，这项税的实施时间本就紧张，如今又遇到阻碍。

segments.en: The city wants to collect all of the money this year and in the next couple of months.
segments.zh: 市政府希望在今年及未来几个月内完成征税。

segments.en: So every day of delay is another difficulty. This has been something that Zoraan Mamdani has really been driving home.
segments.zh: 因此，每拖延一天都会增加难度，这也是穆罕默德一直强调的。

segments.en: I mean, I've even seen videos of him talking about this tax on social media.
segments.zh: 我甚至看到他在社交媒体上谈论这项税的视频。

segments.en: How much of this is kind of a loss for him or at least a step back for what he's trying to do.
segments.zh: 这对他来说算不算一种挫败，或至少是计划受阻？

segments.en: I think he's gotten a lot of unintentional blowback or a blowback that he didn't anticipate in response to the way that this tax was rolled out.
segments.zh: 我认为他收到了很多非预期的反弹，或者说他未曾预料到的反弹，针对这项税收的推出方式。

segments.en: He pitched it as a tax on the wealthiest of the wealthy, on foreign people who have second homes in New York, and instead the city published a list of 900,000 different properties
segments.zh: 他将其定位为对最富有者、在纽约拥有第二套住房的外国人的税收，但相反，该市公布了一份包含90万处房产的名单。

segments.en: and sent out letters to 17,000 different property owners, many of whom we and other news outlets
segments.zh: 并向1.7万名房产所有者发送了信函，其中许多人是我们和其他新闻媒体……
